title: Minimum distance classification for nonlinear dynamical systems
abstract: arXiv:2601.04058v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We address the problem of classifying trajectories or sequences generated by nonlinear dynamical systems, where each class corresponds to a distinct dynamical system. We propose Dynafit, a kernel-based method that learns a distance metric between training data and the underlying dynamics. New observations are assigned to the class whose dynamics best fit the observations according to the learned metric.The learning algorithm approximates the Koopman operator, which globally linearizes the dynamics in a (potentially infinite-dimensional) feature space associated with a kernel function. The distance metric is computed in the feature space independently of its dimensionality by exploiting the kernel trick commonly used in machine learning. The kernel function can be tailored to incorporate prior knowledge of the dynamics when available. translated_title: 面向非线性动力系统的最小距离分类
translated_abstract: 我们研究了将由非线性动力系统生成的轨迹或序列进行分类的问题，其中每个类别对应一个不同的动力系统。我们提出了Dynafit，一种基于核方法的技术，用于学习训练数据与底层动力学之间的距离度量。根据学习到的度量，新的观测数据被分配到其动力学最能拟合该观测数据的类别。该学习算法通过逼近Koopman算子，在与核函数相关的（可能是无限维的）特征空间中对动力学进行全局线性化。通过利用机器学习中常用的核技巧，距离度量可以在特征空间中计算，且与特征空间的维度无关。当可以获得动力学的先验知识时，还可以对核函数进行定制以融入这些先验信息。我们考虑了一个经典的测试例子——作为离散动力系统的逻辑斯蒂映射（logistic map），并推导了…
tldr: 本文提出了Dynafit方法，通过逼近Koopman算子并结合核技巧学习训练数据与底层动力学之间的距离度量，实现对非线性动力系统生成轨迹的最小距离分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dynafit, a kernel-based method that approximates the Koopman operator to learn a distance metric between training data and underlying dynamics, enabling minimum distance classification of trajectories generated by nonlinear dynamical systems.
